places.name: Junction Kassaveti / Levidou / Kyriazi / Agiou Dimitriou (player spawn)
places.description: Five-arm junction 160 m east of Kifisias Avenue where the shop block of Kassaveti ends. Kassaveti arrives from the west (one-way eastbound, two lanes, plus the two-way cycle track on its south side) and continues east as a one-lane street; Levidou leaves to the north-east (one-way, first block a shared-surface lane of grey blocks with dense black/yellow bollards); Kyriazi arrives from the south (one-way northbound, one lane); Agiou Dimitriou leaves to the south-west. No traffic lights: give-way/stop signs and zebra crossings on the arms. Corners: Mythos Plus and Goody's/Everest on the north-west corner (Everest exactly on the Levidou corner), AB Vasilopoulos filling the south-west corner (corner of Kyriazi), the Kifisia Tower (Pyrgos Kifisias, La Pasteria) on the south-east corner, and PAUL in a villa set back behind its garden on the east side of the first block of Levidou.

places.name: Πλατεία Πλατάνου (Platanos Square)
places.description: Kifisia's central square on the east side of Kifisias Avenue at the bottom of Kassaveti, named after its old plane tree. The 'square' is a planted, elongated traffic island (OSM landuse=grass, 57 x 14 m, long axis NW-SE) with the plane tree near its north end, a decorative municipal fountain at its south end, a row of trees along its east edge, and the one-way slip road 'Plateia Platanou' running round it. Bus stops PLATEIA PLATANOU (with shelter and bench, line 71 etc.) and PLATEIA KIFISIAS are at its edges; the Alsos (grove) begins across the slip road to the west and the Platanos underground car park (621 spaces, Adrianou 6) lies to the south-west. Signalised zebra crossings link it to the bottom of Kassaveti. The north side of Kassaveti's first block is the long neoclassical building Kassaveti 1 (HSBC on the ground floor) in front of which the yellow taxis queue along the kerb (photo r11).

places.name: Σταθμός Κηφισιάς (Kifisia station, Line 1 terminus)
places.description: Northern terminus of Athens Metro Line 1 (the former ISAP electric railway), at grade, 25.655 km from Piraeus; on the site of the 1885 station of the Lavrion Square-Strofyli railway; opened for the electric line in 1957, renovated for the 2004 Olympics. Two through platforms with two tracks ending in buffer stops at the south end (x=-378, z=-120), and the Line 1 depot sidings to the west. The station building is a single-storey neoclassical pavilion (OSM 16.1 x 7.7 m) painted ochre-yellow with white pilasters and trim, a low white pediment with a round clock in the centre, and a white fascia sign 'ΚΗΦΙΣΙΑ / KIFISSIA' with the ISAP/STASY logo over the central door; green-painted doors. In front: a forecourt with taxi rank, bus terminus (AFETIRIA ST. KIFISIAS), bicycle stands and two lit decorative fountains, edged by dark-green steel railings with diagonal-cross panels.

places.name: Άλσος Κηφισιάς «Δημήτρης Ζωμόπουλος» (Kifisia Grove)
places.description: Municipal park between Platanos square (east) and the station (west), created around 1901 when the railway company landscaped the ground linking the station with the square. OSM area 22,855 m2: a wedge from x=-358 (station side) to x=-84 (square side), z=-104 to 48, outline (-358,-11) (-111,48) (-95,21) (-84,-17) (-85,-27) (-345,-104). Formal layout (aerial r05): straight gravel/earth walks bordered by clipped box hedges and oval/rectangular beds, a round fountain at a crossing of walks, tall trees (Atlas/Himalayan cedars, stone and Aleppo pines, palms, planes, a registered carob tree), agaves and rough grass. Venue of the annual Flower Show (Anthokomiki Ekthesi, ~20 stremmata, late April to May) with rows of growers' stalls. Old riveted green iron water tank on a cast-iron column frame with a Greek inscription band (r07) at its east end near Platanos. 4-6 gates (sources disagree).

places.name: Αγορά Κηφισιάς (the Agora arcade, Kolokotroni)
places.description: Pedestrian shopping courtyard off Kolokotroni (malls 'Foinikes' at Kolokotroni 7, 40 x 30 m, and Kolokotroni 9). Its signature is a white late-19th-century folly: two round turrets with conical roofs clad in copper/bronze-coloured sheet and topped by gilded finials, linked by a gabled centre bay; red clay ridge tiles, a frieze of carved fleur-de-lis ornaments under the eaves, tall arched shop windows. Courtyard floor of white-grey marble slabs with red insets, clipped box hedges in raised beds, tall Washingtonia palms, black lamp posts with two/three opal globes.

elements.size: each turret ~6 m diameter, ~9 m to the eaves, cone ~4 m

places.name: Οικία Κότσικα (Kotsika house, 1910) - Ralph Lauren, Kassaveti 19
places.description: Listed 1910 villa (Wikidata Q122260203) in the Kassaveti 19 courtyard, set back ~17-30 m north of Kassaveti (OSM way 1076768348, map building 425). Three storeys in rough-faced honey-coloured limestone with lighter rusticated quoins and window surrounds, a white moulded string course, steep gables with white carved timber bargeboards (Swiss-cottage style), a canted bay with a first-floor balcony, navy-blue awnings with the shop name in white; clipped shrubs and terracotta planters at the steps. The Starbucks pavilion stands to its WEST in the same courtyard (OSM way 1076768349, x=157.6, z=63.1) - see shops.json.

elements.what: Starbucks pavilion (courtyard, west of the villa)

places.name: Άγιος Δημήτριος Κηφισιάς (Metropolitan church of Kifisia)
places.description: Large Orthodox church (OSM footprint ~27 x 20 m) at the south end of Kyriazi / Agiou Dimitriou with a small park and playground behind it. Cream/white plaster with white marble trim, two square bell towers flanking the west front (three stages, arched openings, small domed tops with crosses), a central dome with red tiles over the crossing, a gold-ground mosaic of the saint in the arch over the triple-arched porch, red tiled roofs. Paved forecourt with steps and railings; cars park around it.

elements.size: 27 x 20 m footprint; towers ~22 m; dome ~18 m (estimates from r13)

places.name: Μουσείο Γουλανδρή Φυσικής Ιστορίας (Goulandris Natural History Museum), Levidou 13
places.description: Museum in a cream neoclassical/chalet mansion: two storeys, white pilasters and window surrounds, steep red-tiled gables with dark-red carved bargeboards and finials, a single-storey wing with a balustraded roof terrace; forecourt of large stone slabs with ancient pithos jars and marble fragments, low stone wall with black railings, exhibition banners between the ground-floor windows. The GAIA centre is next door (x=163, z=-197) and the Retsinas mansion (x=188, z=-189) is part of the complex.

places.name: Πλατεία Κεφαλαρίου / Άλσος Κεφαλαρίου (Kefalari square and grove)
places.description: Hilltop square and grove 700 m north-east of Platanos (13,039 m2, 137 x 97 m). Large shady trees, wooden benches with backrests (OSM maps 15), metal litter baskets, a rectangular ornamental basin (31 x 14 m) in the middle, the church of the Metamorfosi Sotiros (26 x 18 m) on its west side with a small chapel, a marble drinking fountain inscribed 'ΔΗΜΟΣ ΑΘΗΝΑΙΩΝ 1872', a bronze statue of Pavlos Melas (by Natalia Mela) and busts of Konstantinos Tsatsos and Konstantinos Aktenas; a kiosk on the north corner; children's playground (entrance behind the Eurobank branch). Grand hotels around it (Theoxenia Palace, Semiramis, Pentelikon, SAY).

places.name: Διεθνές Σχολείο της Αθήνας (International School of Athens, ISA)
places.description: Private international school, Artemidos 42 & Xenias, Kefalari/Kifisia 145 62, 1.2 km north-east of Platanos. Official: 'located in a historic building ... main school building set on 6,100 m2 of landscaped grounds', multipurpose outdoor courts for basketball, volleyball, handball, mini-soccer and street hockey, a separate playground for the lower school; uses nearby municipal gym/pitch. OSM: school ground polygon 92.8 x 42.4 m (3,834 m2 - smaller than the official 6,100 m2, so the OSM outline is probably incomplete), one multi-sport court 32.3 x 18.6 m (fits a 28 x 15 m basketball court with run-off) at x=899, z=-450 and a small soccer pitch 31.5 x 16.2 m at x=914, z=-451 side by side, the main building 51.4 x 33.7 m north of the courts (x=902, z=-413), two gates (x=831.6, z=-385.1 and x=869.3, z=-445.3). The EYDAP water tower (x=876.5, z=-495) and a pine wood lie just south. A school directory describes the main building as 'adapted for educational purposes from a neo-classical, four-storey former hotel' and the school brochure (search snippet) gives ~6,000 m2 of floor space - consistent with 4 storeys on the 51.4 x 33.7 m OSM footprint (1,662 m2 x 4 = 6,650 m2). An older version of the school's campus page (search snippet) says the building dates 'from the early 1900s', recently renovated. So: a 4-storey neoclassical former hotel of the early 1900s (cf. the similar former Palace hotel, places.json palace_hotel). Colour/details NOT confirmed by a photo.
